description: This Scala source file defines the class FileBasedWriteAheadLogReader, which reads write-ahead log files in the Spark Streaming framework. It sequentially reads bytebuffer records from a specified file, handling EOF and IO exceptions, and implements Closeable and Iterator interfaces.

classes.name: FileBasedWriteAheadLogReader
classes.description: A reader class for sequentially reading bytebuffer records from a write-ahead log file in Spark Streaming.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there is a next ByteBuffer to read, attempting to read from the input stream if needed.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next ByteBuffer record, throwing an exception if called improperly.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the input stream and marks the reader as closed.
